Package com.egradx.audit.query

Record Class EgradxAuditQuery

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.egradx.audit.query.EgradxAuditQuery
Record Components:
organizationId - whose records: required unless platform. With platform, narrows to one organization
platform - read across organizations — for platform administrators only
platformOnly - with platform: only records that belong to no organization
actions - exact actions
actionPrefix - actions starting with this, e.g. auth.password.
from - inclusive
to - exclusive
correlationId - a request id or a trace id — everything one request or trace recorded
changedField - records where this field (a dotted path) changed
text - a fragment of the entity's or actor's label, the entity id, or the action
public record EgradxAuditQuery(UUID organizationId, boolean platform, boolean platformOnly, Set<UUID> actorIds, Set<EgradxAuditActor.Type> actorTypes, Set<String> actions, String actionPrefix, Set<String> categories, String entityType, String entityId, Set<EgradxAuditOutcome> outcomes, Instant from, Instant to, String correlationId, String changedField, String text) extends Record
Which records to read. Every filter is optional, and they combine: set several and a record must match them all.
